XU4 Legacy Edition

Ultima IV recreated, with gamepad and console style menus. It plays your own copy of the DOS game (ultima4.zip, free from GOG), which is not included.

Steam Deck and Linux (Flatpak)

Install XU4 Legacy Edition

Open the downloaded file and Discover (or GNOME Software) installs the game. Updates then arrive with your other Flatpaks. Or in a terminal:

flatpak install --user @SITE@/flatpak/xu4-legacy.flatpakref

Windows, macOS and other downloads

On the releases page. Setup steps for every platform are in the README.
